hypothesis: Template generation with a validated small pool (<= 2 candidates) finds the consequential gap as often as a larger pool with less burden.

variants.description: template generator emits at most 1 candidate question(s) per request
template generator emits at most 2 candidate question(s) per request
template generator emits at most 4 candidate question(s) per request

config.pooled: train+validation (nothing is fitted in this experiment, so train families are not a leak); same gaps, retriever and assessor for every size

acceptanceCriteria: smallest pool whose consequential-gap-found rate is within 0.02 of the best -> ship (EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md E05)
